question_text: Outline what connectionless means for UDP transport.
adaptation_rationale: Retains connectionless communication concept using UDP,an explicitly named2027 transport protocol,in place of unrestrictedIP taxonomy.
solution: The sender can send datagrams without first establishing a transport connection/handshake. Each datagram is handled independently rather than as part of a guaranteed reliable ordered stream.

marking_points.criterion: Independent datagrams/no guaranteed reliable ordered stream.
